name: Kagari Amagase
source:
Kagari is a prince of Kogyoku, a nation of cherry blossoms and chaos.  On the contrary to his doll-like appearance, he loves fighting and battles.  Hence, his nickname Yasha.  However, he has a surprising secret and weakness...

"Would you be worth killing, princess?"

[From in-game profile]
